stories.title: Workspace Scaffolding
acceptanceCriteria: Cargo.toml workspace exists at project root with 4 members: crates/inference, crates/tools, crates/runtime, crates/cli
cargo check --workspace compiles with zero errors
Binary crate 'zipcode' is defined in crates/cli/Cargo.toml
.gitignore excludes /target and *.gguf files
models/.gitkeep exists

stories.title: Tool Trait + Registry
acceptanceCriteria: Tool trait defined with name(), description(), parameters_schema(), execute() methods
ToolRegistry supports register(), get(), specs(), names()
ToolResult supports truncation at 8192 bytes with suffix message
PermissionMode enum has ReadOnly, WorkspaceWrite, FullAccess variants
cargo test -p zipcode-tools passes all registry tests (>=5 tests)

stories.title: Inference Types + Gemma 4 Chat Template
acceptanceCriteria: ChatMessage struct supports user(), system(), assistant(), tool_result() constructors
GenerationConfig has temperature=0.7, top_p=0.9, max_tokens=4096 defaults
format_conversation() produces Gemma 4 turn format with <start_of_turn>/<end_of_turn> tags
parse_tool_calls() extracts ToolCallParsed from <tool_call> tags in model output
parse_tool_calls() returns empty vec when no tool calls present
cargo test -p zipcode-inference passes all tests (>=8 tests)

stories.title: File Operation Tools (read, write, edit)
acceptanceCriteria: ReadFileTool reads file with line numbers, supports offset/limit params
WriteFileTool creates files and parent directories
EditFileTool replaces unique string match, fails on not-found or duplicates
All three tools resolve relative paths against ToolContext.cwd
cargo test -p zipcode-tools -- read_file write_file edit_file passes (>=7 tests)

stories.title: Search Tools (glob, grep)
acceptanceCriteria: GlobSearchTool finds files matching glob patterns like *.rs
GrepSearchTool searches file contents with regex, returns file:line: format
GrepSearchTool supports glob filter parameter for file type filtering
Both tools handle empty results gracefully
cargo test -p zipcode-tools -- glob_search grep_search passes (>=5 tests)

stories.title: Bash Tool
acceptanceCriteria: BashTool executes shell commands via bash -c
Captures both stdout and stderr
Reports non-zero exit codes
Uses ToolContext.cwd as working directory
cargo test -p zipcode-tools -- bash passes (>=4 tests)

stories.title: Utility Tools (todo, repl, agent, tool_search)
acceptanceCriteria: TodoWriteTool persists todos to .zipcode-todos.json
ToolSearchTool searches by name and description keywords
ReplTool executes python3 -c and node -e
AgentTool returns 'not yet implemented' stub message
cargo test -p zipcode-tools -- todo_write tool_search passes (>=4 tests)

stories.title: Inference Engine (candle GGUF + Gemma 4)
acceptanceCriteria: InferenceEngine::load() accepts model_path, tokenizer_path, device
select_device() returns Cuda or Cpu based on availability
Sampler supports greedy (temperature=0), top-k, top-p sampling
generate_stream() returns mpsc::Receiver<TokenEvent>
cargo check -p zipcode-inference compiles with zero errors

stories.title: Runtime Config + Permission + Session
acceptanceCriteria: ZipcodeConfig loads from ~/.zipcode/config.json with project .zipcode.json override
PermissionPolicy.check() returns Allowed/NeedsApproval/Denied based on mode
ReadOnly mode blocks bash/write_file, allows read_file/grep_search
Session saves/loads JSON to ~/.zipcode/sessions/{id}.json
cargo test -p zipcode-runtime passes all tests (>=8 tests)

stories.title: System Prompt + Conversation Loop
acceptanceCriteria: build_system_prompt() includes base role, permission mode, cwd, .zipcode.md content
ConversationLoop.run_turn() implements generate->parse->execute->repeat cycle
StreamCallback trait has on_token, on_tool_start, on_tool_result, on_permission_prompt
Tool results are injected back into conversation history
cargo check -p zipcode-runtime compiles with zero errors

stories.title: CLI (REPL + One-Shot + Doctor)
acceptanceCriteria: clap argument parser defines --model, --permission-mode flags and prompt/doctor subcommands
doctor command checks binary version, CUDA availability, model file presence
REPL uses rustyline with /help, /status, /clear, /quit slash commands
One-shot mode runs single prompt and exits
cargo check -p zipcode compiles with zero errors

stories.title: Packaging Scripts
acceptanceCriteria: scripts/install.sh creates ~/.zipcode/models and ~/.zipcode/sessions directories
scripts/package.sh builds release binary and creates ZIP archive
scripts/download_model.sh provides instructions for Gemma 4 GGUF download
All scripts are executable (chmod +x)

stories.title: Integration + Full Build
acceptanceCriteria: cargo test --workspace passes all unit tests
cargo build --release -p zipcode produces binary at target/release/zipcode
cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings shows zero warnings
cargo fmt --all -- --check shows no formatting issues
./target/release/zipcode doctor runs without panic
